### 4. Scored parameters (billing date = payment date = 2026-10-14)

**Return fee** (return_fee_amount: "The basis of the return fee is set first and every reduction that applies is then subtracted"): basis — return_fee_basis_for_new_kestrel_holdings branch 2: active lease dated 41 days before the return (outside 30, within 90) -> lower of tier 3 fee 450.00 and disposition fee 395.00 = 395.00. Reductions: autopay 10 payments -> 40.00 ("10 or more | USD 40.00"); early return 7 days before maturity -> 75.00 ("At least 1 but fewer than 15"); multi-line: one active line (lease) -> 50.00; payment record: 1 late charge (2025-12-06), 0 returned payments in 12 months -> 25.00. Fee = 395.00 - 40 - 75 - 50 - 25 = **205.00**.

**Excess mileage charge**: odometer standard: sign-in 41198 vs inspection 41236, gap 38 (1..100) -> lower 41198; miles driven 41198 - 9 = 41189. Allowance: returned before maturity -> 36000 x 1103/1110 (days 2023-09-11->2026-09-18 / ->2026-09-25) = 35772.97 -> 35773. Forgiveness: tolerance Tier 3 with 1 late charge in 24 months (2024-10-06 is exactly 24 whole months before -> excluded) -> 500; return-to-brand: active lease dated 41 days before return -> 1500; advance election 2026-08-20 is 36 days before maturity -> 300. Excess miles 41189 - 35773 - 2300 = 3116. Rate: closed new-vehicle retail contract -> 0.25 - 0.05 = 0.20. Charge **623.20**.

**Excess wear charge**: forgiveness Tier 3 cap 250.00 replaced by standing benefit (no returned payment, 11 >= 10 payments in 12 months) -> 500.00; proration (returned early) 500 x 1103/1110 = 496.85. Credits: tenure (closed new retail signed 2016-04-02, 125 whole months) 150.00; on-time (late charge installment due 2025-11-25 -> return 2026-09-18 = 9 whole months) 100.00; return-to-brand (active lease within 60 days) 400.00. Chargeable 1386.40 - 496.85 - 650.00 = 239.55; share Tier 3 with 1 late charge in 12 months -> 0.75 -> 179.6625 -> **179.66**.

**Return balance payment** (return_balance_payment_amount): return charges RC = 205.00 + 623.20 + 179.66 = 1007.86; fees standing from before the return = fees due (25.00 + RC) - RC = 25.00. Part of RC paid now: plan length Tier 3, no returned payment in 12 months -> n = floor(1007.86/300)=3 (within 2..4) -> 335.95; minimum share: 1 late charge in 24 months -> 0.35 x RC = 352.75; "where more than one figure is set ... the larger is used" -> 352.751. Prior fees: late charge in 12 months but none in 6 months (none after 2026-04-14) -> 0.5 x 25.00 = 12.50. Relationship deferral: active lease at 0 dpd only -> 50.00 moved. Up-front: returned payment within 24 but not 12 months -> +40.00. Payment = 352.751 + 12.50 - 50.00 + 40.00 = 355.251 -> **355.25** (not above fees due 1032.86, not below 0).

Fall-back answers (computation document alone, no factor): return fee 450.00 (Tier 3 schedule); excess mileage (41236-9-36000)=5227 x 0.25 = 1306.75; excess wear 1386.40-250.00 = 1136.40; return balance payment = 25.00 + RC (with the baseline charges 25.00 + 2893.15 = 2918.15). ### 6. Problem tree (visible materials only)
Root: return balance payment (customer's own write). return_balance_payment "When the payment is fixed": "The return balance payment is fixed only after the excess mileage charge for the return stands billed on the contract. The return balance payment is not fixed until the excess wear charge for the return stands billed on the contract. Before the return balance payment is fixed, the return fee for the return must stand billed on the contract." Records: no return_charge entries of any kind in the posting history -> all three states unmet.
- Hop A (excess mileage billed) — **state-derived**: searched "excess mileage charge ... returned" -> excess_mileage_charge_billing: "Once booked, the excess mileage charge stands billed on the contract: it shows in the contract's posting history as a return charge entry and is included in the contract's fees due balance."
- Hop B (excess wear billed) — **state-derived**: excess_wear_charge_billing: "After it, the excess wear charge stands billed on the contract and appears both in the posting history and in the fees due balance."
- Hop C (return fee billed) — **state-derived**: return_fee_billing: "The return fee then stands billed on the contract: it shows in the posting history and in the fees due balance."
No hop below A/B/C: billing docs state no prerequisite sentence; their conditions (status returned, dispute period, inspection on file) already hold. Order: A, B, C in any order, then the root. No hop was pre-solved: the return balance payment doc names no billing tool, and no doc aggregates the three.

### Counter-proofs
- "Only do the one thing asked" (hand over the payment now): excluded — the payment "has no fixed amount while any one of the excess mileage charge, the excess wear charge or the return fee for the return does not yet stand billed on the contract", and the amount doc defines return charges as "the total of the return charge entries of those three kinds in the contract's posting history" (currently none).
- Closest alternatives: pay the whole bill (excluded by the customer's request + plan length/min share giving the smallest part payable now); base clauses 6/7/8 of the vehicle return rule (marked "no longer in force" for a customer within the holding limits); the record's `excess_miles` 5227 (base clause figure, superseded); waiving the 25.00 late charge (status returned blocks waivers); return fee waiver (branch 1 needs a holding within 30 days; lease is 41 days away); billing before the dispute period (elapsed).
